title: Region satin is a zigzag across the column
description: A 5 × 2 mm rectangle sewn in satin at 90°, density 3, without under sewing, must be sewn as PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews it: from its start point in the middle of the bottom edge, along that edge to one end, a sawtooth back to the middle (one crossing along the sewing direction, the next slanted, never a short stitch between rows as in the old square wave), the last row 0.2 mm short of the start point, then the same for the other half, and a tie-in and end lock.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md item 1 (Defect: a square wave is wrong regardless of PE-DESIGN)
Region sewing attributes: satin is shown only in pictures

PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-1 reference (PR #34) was made with under sewing on, PE's default: 40 stitches, of which 13-15 are under sewing. Under sewing is off here so the spec tests the top satin's shape only (coordinator decision, 2026-10-27); the reference is to be remade with under sewing off.

PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): 27 stitches = tie-in, run to the left end, sawtooth back to the middle, run to the right end, sawtooth back, end lock; PE starts and ends a Rectangle tool shape in the middle of its bottom edge.

PE-DESIGN 11.50 starts and ends a Rectangle tool shape's region sewing in the middle of its bottom edge (this reference, and the fill rectangles of fill-frequency-0/25/50). OpenStitch has no such default yet, so the script places the start and end point there.

references.make: In Layout & Editing, on a 100 × 100 mm Design Page, draw a rectangle 5 mm wide and 2 mm high with its top-left corner at (10, 10) mm. Line sewing off; region sew type Satin Stitch, Direction 90°, Density 3.0 lines/mm, Under Sewing off, every other attribute at its default (note pull compensation in the manifest). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

machine.make: Sew target/compat/work/satin-zigzag-rect/satin.pes on a Brother machine on medium-weight woven cotton with tear-away stabiliser; look for needle holes or ragged thread along the two long edges (there should be none) and record the result.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): 27 stitches. Was 15 ±1 (audit item 1, top satin only).

PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): 7 short edge stitches, all at the start point: the tie-in (1), the 0.2–0.3 mm hops to and from the last row of each half (4) and the end lock (2). Was 0 (audit item 1).
audit item 1: every needle point is on one of the two edges

PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): 0.5926 (the runs along the edge to each end and the hops at the start point do not cross). Was 1.0 (audit item 1).
PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): the shortest stitches are the 0.2 mm hops and lock. Was ≥ 1.95 mm (audit item 1).

PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): the slanted stitch back to the next row is 2.09–2.12 mm (rows 2/3 mm apart). Was 2.1 (audit item 1).
